description: Research r17 (dev only, H200): r16 mal0_st500 (r5 a01_fp32_lr1e-6_skip_cos_mal0 with the cosine to 0.1x counted over 500 steps, budget_steps 500, no time stop) plus malformed_reward_solved -0.5: truncated outputs score -0.5 in groups with a correct sample (0 elsewhere). r16's three finished seeds ended 0.232 / 0.405 / 0.412; seed 0 had 54-64 % of its training outputs truncated from step 300 and slid at steps 451-500 (reward 0.40 to 0.26, truncated 0.54 to 0.64, entropy 0.03) at lr ~1e-7. The penalty in solved groups pushes toward finishing the search within 1,024 tokens without pushing unsolved groups toward one quick guess. Compare with r16's H200 seeds (step-capped, so the GPU type doesn't change the trajectory).
